# 1 Samuel Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 157r–158r | **Source Image:** 1SA_014_page_001.jpg, 1SA_014_page_002.jpg, 1SA_014_page_003.jpg

---

**14:1** And-it-was [on]-the-day, and-said Jonathan son of-Saul to-the-young-man carrying his-weapons, "Come and-let-us-cross-over to-[the]-garrison of-[the]-Philistines which [is] on-the-other-side of-this." But-to-his-father he-did-not tell.

**14:2** And-Saul [was]-dwelling at-[the]-outskirts of-Gibeah, under the-pomegranate-tree which [is] in-Migron. And-the-people who [were] with-him [were]-about six-hundred men.

**14:3** And-Ahijah son of-Ahitub, brother of-Ichabod, son of-Phinehas, son of-Eli, priest of-YHWH in-Shiloh, [was]-wearing an-ephod. And-the-people did-not know that Jonathan had-gone.

**14:4** And-between the-passes by-which Jonathan sought to-cross-over to-[the]-garrison of-[the]-Philistines [there was] a-tooth of-rock [shen ha-sela'] from-this-side, and-a-tooth of-rock from-that-side. And-[the]-name of-the-one [was] Bozez, and-[the]-name of-the-other [was] Seneh.

**14:5** The-one tooth [was]-a-pillar from-[the]-north, opposite Michmash, and-the-one from-[the]-south, opposite Geba.

**14:6** And-said Jonathan to-the-young-man carrying his-weapons, "Come and-let-us-cross-over to-[the]-garrison of-these uncircumcised-ones. Perhaps YHWH will-work for-us, for-there-is-not for-YHWH [any]-restraint to-save by-many or-by-few."

**14:7** And-said to-him his-armor-bearer, "Do all that [is] in-your-heart. Turn for-yourself. Behold-me with-you, according-to-your-heart."

**14:8** And-said Jonathan, "Behold, we [are]-crossing-over to the-men, and-we-will-reveal-ourselves to-them.

**14:9** If thus they-say to-us, 'Stand still until we-reach you,' then-we-will-stand in-our-place and-not go-up to-them.

**14:10** But-if thus they-say, 'Come-up to-us,' then-we-will-go-up, for YHWH has-given them into-our-hand. And-this [shall be] for-us the-sign."

**14:11** And-revealed-themselves [the]-two-of-them to-[the]-garrison of-[the]-Philistines. And-said [the]-Philistines, "Behold, Hebrews [are]-coming-out from-the-holes where they-hid-themselves."

**14:12** And-answered [the]-men of-the-garrison Jonathan and-his-armor-bearer and-said, "Come-up to-us, and-we-will-make-you-know a-thing." And-said Jonathan to-his-armor-bearer, "Come-up after-me, for YHWH has-given them into-[the]-hand of-Israel."

**14:13** And-climbed-up Jonathan upon his-hands and-upon his-feet, and-his-armor-bearer after-him. And-they-fell before Jonathan, and-his-armor-bearer [was]-putting-to-death after-him.

**14:14** And-was the-first striking which Jonathan and-his-armor-bearer struck, about twenty men, in-about half a-furrow of-a-yoke of-field.

**14:15** And-there-was trembling in-the-camp, in-the-field, and-among-all the-people; the-garrison and-the-raiders — they-also trembled. And-the-earth quaked, and-it-became a-trembling of-God [cherdat Elohim].

**14:16** And-saw the-watchmen of-Saul in-Gibeah of-Benjamin, and-behold, the-multitude melted-away and-went here and-there.

**14:17** And-said Saul to-the-people who [were] with-him, "Number, please, and-see who has-gone from-us." And-they-numbered, and-behold, Jonathan and-his-armor-bearer [were]-not [there].

**14:18** And-said Saul to-Ahijah, "Bring-near the-ark of-God" — for the-ark of-God was on-that-day with-[the]-sons of-Israel.

**14:19** And-it-was while Saul spoke to-the-priest, that-the-tumult which [was] in-[the]-camp of-[the]-Philistines went, going and-increasing. And-said Saul to-the-priest, "Withdraw your-hand."

**14:20** And-was-summoned Saul and-all the-people who [were] with-him, and-they-came to-the-battle. And-behold, [the]-sword of-each [was] against-his-neighbor — a-very great confusion [mehumah].

**14:21** And-the-Hebrews [who] were for-[the]-Philistines as-formerly, who went-up with-them into-the-camp round-about — they-also [turned] to-be with-Israel who [were] with-Saul and-Jonathan.

**14:22** And-all the-men of-Israel, the-[ones]-hiding in-[the]-hill-country of-Ephraim, heard that [the]-Philistines had-fled, and-they-also pursued after-them in-the-battle.

**14:23** And-saved YHWH Israel on-that day, and-the-battle passed-over to-Beth-aven.

**14:24** And-the-men of-Israel were-hard-pressed on-that day. And-Saul-adjured the-people, saying, "Cursed [is] the-man who eats food until the-evening and-until I-have-avenged-myself from-my-enemies." And-not any of-the-people tasted food.

**14:25** And-all [the people of]-the-land came into-the-forest, and-there-was honey upon-[the]-face of-the-field.

**14:26** And-the-people came into-the-forest, and-behold, a-flow of-honey, but-no-one put his-hand to-his-mouth, for the-people feared the-oath.

**14:27** But-Jonathan had-not heard when-his-father-adjured the-people. And-he-stretched-out the-end of-the-staff which [was] in-his-hand and-dipped it in-[the]-honeycomb, and-returned his-hand to-his-mouth, and-his-eyes brightened.

**14:28** And-answered a-man from-the-people and-said, "Your-father strictly-adjured the-people, saying, 'Cursed [is] the-man who eats food today.'" And-the-people were-faint.

**14:29** And-said Jonathan, "My-father has-troubled the-land. See, please, how my-eyes have-brightened because I-tasted a-little of-this honey.

**14:30** How-much-more if indeed the-people had-eaten today from-[the]-spoil of-their-enemies which they-found, for now [would]-not the-striking among-[the]-Philistines have-been greater?"

**14:31** And-they-struck on-that day [the]-Philistines from-Michmash to-Aijalon, and-the-people were-very faint.

**14:32** And-the-people rushed to-the-spoil and-took sheep and-cattle and-calves and-slaughtered [them] on-the-ground, and-the-people ate with the-blood.

**14:33** And-they-told Saul, saying, "Behold, the-people are-sinning against-YHWH by-eating with the-blood." And-he-said, "You-have-acted-treacherously. Roll to-me today a-great stone."

**14:34** And-said Saul, "Scatter among-the-people and-say to-them, 'Bring-near to-me each his-ox and-each his-sheep, and-slaughter here and-eat, and-do-not sin against-YHWH by-eating with the-blood.'" And-brought all the-people each his-ox in-his-hand that-night and-slaughtered [them] there.

**14:35** And-built Saul an-altar to-YHWH; it [was] the-first he-began to-build [as]-an-altar to-YHWH.

**14:36** And-said Saul, "Let-us-go-down after [the]-Philistines [by]-night and-plunder them until-[the]-light of-the-morning, and-let-us-not leave among-them a-man." And-they-said, "All the-good in-your-eyes, do." And-said the-priest, "Let-us-draw-near here to-God."

**14:37** And-Saul asked of-God, "Shall-I-go-down after [the]-Philistines? Will-You-give them into-[the]-hand of-Israel?" But-He-did-not answer him on-that day.

**14:38** And-said Saul, "Draw-near here, all the-corners [pinnot] of-the-people, and-know and-see in-what this sin has-been today.

**14:39** For [as]-YHWH lives, the-[one]-saving Israel, even if it-is in-Jonathan my-son, he-shall-surely die." But-no-one answered him from-all the-people.

**14:40** And-he-said to-all Israel, "You shall-be on-one side, and-I and-Jonathan my-son shall-be on-the-other side." And-the-people said to-Saul, "The-good in-your-eyes, do."

**14:41** And-said Saul to-YHWH, God of-Israel, "Give [a]-perfect-[lot] [tamim]." And-was-taken Jonathan and-Saul, and-the-people went-out.

**14:42** And-said Saul, "Cast between-me and-between Jonathan my-son." And-was-taken Jonathan.

**14:43** And-said Saul to-Jonathan, "Tell me, what have-you-done?" And-told him Jonathan and-said, "I-indeed tasted with-the-end of-the-staff which [was] in-my-hand a-little honey. Here-I-am; I-will-die."

**14:44** And-said Saul, "Thus may-God-do and-thus may-He-add, for you-shall-surely-die, Jonathan."

**14:45** And-the-people said to-Saul, "Shall-Jonathan die, who has-done this great salvation in-Israel? Far-be-it! [As]-YHWH lives, not a-hair of-his-head shall-fall to-the-ground, for with-God he-has-worked this day." And-the-people ransomed [va-yifdu] Jonathan, and-he-did-not die.

**14:46** And-Saul went-up from-after [the]-Philistines, and-[the]-Philistines went to-their-place.

**14:47** And-Saul took the-kingship over-Israel and-fought round-about against-all his-enemies: against-Moab and-against-[the]-sons of-Ammon and-against-Edom and-against the-kings of-Zobah and-against [the]-Philistines. And-wherever he-turned he-acted-wickedly [yarshia'].

**14:48** And-he-acted-valiantly and-struck Amalek, and-delivered Israel from-[the]-hand of-its-plunderer.

**14:49** And-[the]-sons of-Saul were: Jonathan and-Ishvi and-Malchi-shua. And-[the]-names of-his-two daughters: [the]-name of-the-firstborn [was] Merab, and-[the]-name of-the-younger [was] Michal.

**14:50** And-[the]-name of-[the]-wife of-Saul [was] Ahinoam daughter of-Ahimaaz. And-[the]-name of-the-commander of-his-army [was] Abner son of-Ner, uncle of-Saul.

**14:51** And-Kish [was the]-father of-Saul, and-Ner [the]-father of-Abner [was the]-son of-Abiel.

**14:52** And-there-was fierce war against [the]-Philistines all the-days of-Saul. And-when-Saul saw any mighty-man or-any valiant-man [ben chayil], he-gathered-him to-himself.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **14:18 — "Bring near the ark of God"**: The LXX reads "ephod" instead of "ark," which many scholars prefer since the ephod was the standard oracular instrument and the ark was at Kiriath-jearim. The MT Leningrad Codex reads אֲרוֹן (ark).

2. **14:41 — tamim**: The MT is abbreviated here. The LXX preserves a longer text with the Urim and Thummim lot-casting formula. EMET follows the shorter MT.

3. **14:47 — yarshia'** (יַרְשִׁיעַ): Literally "he acted wickedly/condemned" — a difficult reading. Context suggests "he was victorious" or "he inflicted punishment." Some emend to *yargia'* ("he troubled them"). EMET preserves the MT reading.

— EMET
